title: Kung pao chicken with peanuts and peppers
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet.
Dice the chicken and mix with 1 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tsp cornflour.
Stir the remaining soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, remaining cornflour and 4 tbsp water together.
Stir-fry the chicken in the hot oil in a wok for 4 minutes, add the garlic, ginger, chilli and peppers and fry for 3 more minutes.
Add the sauce, peanuts and spring onions, let it thicken for 1 minute and serve with rice.
